(N + N))).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ ∃ a b : ℕ, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C (u - (N + N))).inputs = [a, b] ∧ a < N ∧ b < N)) ∧ ((N ≤ v ∧ v < N + N) ∨ (N + N ≤ v ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C (v - (N + N))).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ ∃ a b : ℕ, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C (v - (N + N))).inputs = [a, b] ∧ N ≤ a ∧ a < N + N ∧ N ≤ b ∧ b < N + N))) ∨ (((N ≤ u ∧ u < N + N) ∨ (N + N ≤ u ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C (u - (N + N))).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ ∃ a b : ℕ, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C (v - (N + N))).inputs = [a, b] ∧ a < N ∧ b < N)))))) → ∃ C' : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C' ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N + N) C' ∧ C'.size ≤ 3 * C.size ∧ (∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) C' z = true ↔ ∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l) = true) ∧ (∀ j < C'.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C' j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ((∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, (C'.wires (List.ofFn z)).getD (N + N + j) false = true → (C'.wires (List.ofFn (fun ka24 : Fin (N + N) => decide (ka24.val < N) && z ka24))).getD (N + N + j) false = true ∨ (C'.wires (List.ofFn (fun kb25 : Fin (N + N) => decide (N ≤ kb25.val) && z kb25))).getD (N + N + j) false = true ∨ ∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l) = true) ∧ ((∀ p : Fin N, (C'.wires (List.ofFn (fun kc26 : Fin (N + N) => decide (kc26 = Fin.castAdd N p)))).getD (N + N + j) false = false) ∧ ∀ l : Fin N, (C'.wires (List.ofFn (fun kd27 : Fin (N + N) => decide (kd27 = Fin.natAdd N l)))).getD (N + N + j) false = false)))
plain_statement: Call an AND gate good if it is off at every one-hot input and, wherever it is true, it stays true with all lines off, or with all points off, or an incident pair is on. Incidence I of N points and N lines, no two points on two common lines. C: an AND/OR circuit of fan-in at most two, reading earlier wires, true exactly when an incident pair is on, each AND gate good or reading a point input or OR of two point inputs and a line input or OR of two line inputs. Then a circuit of the same kind with at most 3 size(C) gates computes the same function and all its AND gates are good.
title: 4-cycle-free incidence: an exact fan-in-two AND/OR circuit whose unclean ANDs are rectangles of width at most 2 has a clean rewrite at most 3 times its size
